scope: Four Home discovery shortcut images only

prompts.prayer:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one transparent Home shortcut icon for Nur Islam, part of a coordinated four-icon collection. Image 1 is the illustration to redesign; image 2 is the approved prayer-bead icon and is the reference for the collection's tactile matte finish, quiet lighting and tasteful color balance. Redesign ONLY image 1; do not include the reference object or make a collage. Retain the recognizable subject and compact silhouette. Make the four subjects feel made by the SAME illustrator: simplified rounded geometry, matte soft 3D surfaces, subtle material hints without gritty photographic texture, same soft upper-left studio light, same mild three-quarter perspective and gentle grounding shadow, no gloss or dramatic rim lighting. The app has deep forest-green surfaces, warm ivory typography and aged-brass accents. Build a cohesive object palette of warm ivory, muted forest/teal green and small aged-brass accents; natural warm skin color is allowed for hands. Avoid vivid royal blue, bright coral, primary yellow and shiny toy plastic. Calm and refined, not overly ornate. Center one whole object on a square genuinely transparent canvas, approximately 76% of canvas size, equal optical scale across the set, no background tile, no glow, no scenery, no watermark, no pseudo-Arabic or invented sacred text.
Subject: a partially unfurled prayer rug with a rolled far edge. Muted deep teal-green cloth, warm ivory plain border and a simple ivory mihrab outline, restrained sand-colored fringe. Simplify the current busy tassels and high-frequency fibers. One continuous believable rug, no person, no floor, no additional objects or text.
